job.question: Which retirement plan's investment consulting RFP requires that, as of December 31, 2024, the firm have at least three public fund clients each with at least $1B in assets and have been in business at least ten years?
job.expected_facts: The Retirement Plan for CTA Employees (Chicago Transit Authority), in its April 29, 2025 investment consulting RFP.
job.acceptance: Retirement Plan for CTA/Chicago Transit Authority Employees; publication date is optional.

reviews.reason: This is the City of Madison Police Officers’ and Firefighters’ Retirement System RFP, not the CTA Employees plan’s RFP. Its mandatory minimum specifies five years of public-pension management or advisory experience; the document does not establish the stated ten-year and three $1 billion public-fund-client requirements.
quotes: The Board of Trustees for the City of Madison Police Officer’s & Firefighters’ Retirement System (the “Board”) is soliciting Requests for Proposals (RFP) for Investment Consulting firms
2-2 Minimum Requirements. Consultant must satisfy the following mandatory minimum requirements in order to have their Responses evaluated.
Minimum of five-year record of actual management/advisory of assets in the public pension fund sector.
